patches.reason: Outside a team-signed iOS install (e.g. PlayCover) the keychain item has no kSecAttrAccessGroup, so getBundleSeedID calls -[NSString initWithString:nil] and throws during tr::UserTracker::sessionStart -> ubisoftDeviceUniqueId. Always return the existing constant @"unknown" (CFString at 0x100d73c38) instead; execution falls through to the function's normal cleanup/return at 0x100adb2a8.

Only place that reads the Ads_enabled / Interstitials_enabled settings and starts the ad SDKs (AdMob rewarded video + 'Trials Interstitial End Run' interstitial, Tapjoy, Domob). Returning immediately is equivalent to Ads_enabled = 0, a configuration the game supports; tr::AdInterface::init() is a tail call to it. Stops ad SDK network traffic and ad views under PlayCover.
Decides from play counters alone and never checks that an ad SDK was initialised; always answer false so the game never attempts an interstitial (e.g. at the end of a run).
Always report no rewarded video available, so the game does not offer watch-an-ad rewards that can no longer work.
